next_tickets.title: S16q: acquire DAQ-provenanced B-stack forced/random pedestal ROOT for direct hidden-mode validation
next_tickets.body: Locate or acquire true non-beam B-stack forced/random pedestal ROOT with trigger-code provenance, then score the frozen S16k hidden-mode methods without timing-tail labels. Expected information gain: converts the current absence-gated proxy confirmation into a direct electronics-nuisance truth test.
